title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 6:9-13
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 6:9-13</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group title="The Lord's Prayer" type="primary">
      <group title="Addressed to “You” the Father" type="secondary">
        <group>
          Our Father who is in the skies, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">may your</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">name</char> be recognized as holy, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">may your</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">kingdom</char> come, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">and may your</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">desire</char> be done, 
        </group>
        <group>
          as it is in the skies, 
        </group>
        <group>
          so also on the land. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group title="How “We” Can Participate in the Father’s Kingdom and Will" type="secondary">
        <group title="Provision" type="primary-alt">
          <group>
            Our daily provision of bread, 
          </group>
          <group>
            give to us today. 
          </group>
        </group>
        <group title="Forgiveness" type="primary-alt">
          <group>
            And forgive us our debts, 
          </group>
          <group>
            just as we also have forgiven those indebted to us. 
          </group>
        </group>
        <group title="Deliverance" type="primary-alt">
          <group>
            And don’t lead us to be tested, 
          </group>
          <group>
            but deliver us from the evil one. 
          </group>
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
